messages:
olivia (sec): Quick FYI - KMS key rotate happened overnight. A handful of base-image verifications failed in prod (cosign). Not urgent but we need a small, auditable handoff before any re-sign.

sam (infra): saw the alerts. Logged INC-4860. Errors: `cosign verify: signature missing` and `manifest digest mismatch` on some multi-arch indexes. Suspect signer SA perms + cosign plugin version skew.

diego (runtime): can we avoid full rebuilds? If it's signing/m manifest ordering we can reindex and reattach signatures. Runtime can accept a 24h relax flag for verification if we emit extra telemetry.

olivia (sec): constraints: (1) RBAC changes must be scoped to a new `image-rekey-sa` with ONLY `cloudkms.cryptoKeyVersions.asymmetricSign` and no registry/storage write unless absolutely needed, (2) every re-sign must emit an audit event with image, old_sig, new_sig, key_version, operator, and land in auditpipe -> bigquery AND immutable S3 export, (3) run quick vulnerability scan (trivy) post re-sign to detect accidental layer changes.

zoe (oncall): ops playbook excerpt: 
```
# preflight
export BACKUP=s3://redwood-image-backups/pre-rotate/${IMAGE}
aws s3 cp manifest.json ${BACKUP}/manifest.json --acl bucket-owner-full-control
# rekey job (staging first)
kubectl create job rekey --image=redwood/tools:cosign-2.0.3 -- env KMS_KEY=${KMS_KEY} --namespace infra
```

sam (infra): infra will pin cosign to 2.0.3 on the rekey job, pin manifest-tool if we reassemble indexes, and create the `image-rekey-sa` with minimal bindings. Will post IAM binding and job manifest to PR.

ci-bot: created PR github.com/redwood-infra/image-signer/pull/99 by sam - adds rekey job, preflight check, and backup step.

olivia (sec): approve in principle. One more req: add retention policy on the audit export (2y) and mark exported objects `immutable=true`. Also, if trivy finds changed layer digests compared to backups, abort the rollout and escalate to sec + oncall.

diego (runtime): I'll add `verifier.accept_rekey_window=true` behind 10% canary and a telemetry tag `rekey_run=1767777777`. We'll revert after the window.

zoe (oncall): scheduling 2026-04-14T01:00:00Z for 45m canary -> prod run. I'll own oncall during the window. Tag me on failures.

olivia (sec): thanks team. Keep status updates in this thread only. If anything blocks, escalate to sec and oncall immediately. :lock:
